title: ARCADE: BOTH PLAYERS ON PADS
why: His order for the Halloween party mode, build 7 of 20. In the arcade, controller 1 is player 1 and controller 2 is player 2, so two people can walk up and play with no setup. Entering the arcade puts each window on its controller for the session only and tells the other window, and the keyboard and mouse still drive player 1. The controller picks he keeps from the PARTY window are never written while the arcade is on, and leaving the arcade puts his kept picks back. Normal co-op is untouched.
now: In the arcade controller 1 plays player 1 and controller 2 plays player 2, and his kept controller picks come back on leaving.

NET.arcPick=0; NET.arcBoot=0; ARCADE.wantIn=0;
  arcadePadsOut();   // v23.28 (arcade7): his kept controller pick back
